problem_type: Stopping a running paid batch from the card did nothing: the card's close button went through the same busy gate as the actions it was meant to interrupt, and the host refused it on a quote the batch itself had just replaced
symptom: Real app, final head of #947, fixture vendor (2026-10-02): press Generate remaining 6, wait until the host has approved the first one, press × on the card. Nothing happens; all six are sent and the card closes as 'every shot decided', not as 'the user closed it'. Repeated in Chinese and English, with × tried every 2 seconds while 6, 6, 3 and 1 shots were still undecided. Meanwhile the card kept showing the next undecided shot with Remove and Generate this one, as if it were waiting for a click, while the host approved it on its own. Second walk on the fixed head (2026-10-02 afternoon): on a 3-shot card, press Generate this one and × right after it; the × reached the host after the approval had replaced the quote, was refused as generation_quote_changed, and the card stayed open with the other two shots.
direct_cause: src/workbench/ai/v4/useAgentPanelSpendConfirm.ts: discard (the ×) ran through act(), which returns at once while busy is true, and Generate remaining keeps busy true for the whole batch (about 3 seconds per shot). electron/capabilityCore/appIntegrationSpendConfirm.ts discardPendingSpend only accepted the card's current quoteId, while every decision on the card replaces it (each approved shot of Generate remaining, a single Generate this one, Remove), so a × sent with the quote the person saw was refused as generation_quote_changed whenever it arrived after that action.
class_root: The renderer had one gate for every card action and treated the stop like another spend action; the host-level tests for 'stop in the middle' called the host's withdraw directly, so they stayed green while the only path a person can take (the card's ×) never reached it. The same gate swallowed Remove and Generate this one while a single confirm was in flight, without any visible sign.
affected_population: Everyone who presses Generate remaining N and wants to stop it: all N are generated and paid
Everyone who presses Remove / Generate this one / × while a single confirm is still on its way (1-3 seconds): the press is swallowed without any sign
entry_points: The card's 取消 / 先不发了: V4Intervention reject -> useAgentPanelSpendCard.discard (never behind the busy guard) -> productionRunApi.discardSpend -> IPC discard-spend -> appIntegrationSpendConfirm.discardPendingSpend -> generation.withdrawPresentation

Shots already handed to the canvas: the ledger change subscription withdrawQueuedHandOvers (appIntegrationCanvasShot) withdraws every bound consent still queued on the canvas, whichever path closed the card
Typing while the card is open and stopping the turn close the presentation through the lane (withdrawPresentation); the same subscription withdraws the queued consents

The scheduler path (external host, re-shoot / resume observer, external MCP multi-shot): nomi_run_control pause / cancel -> applyRunControl; the run projection carries stopped (shotStopFacts) and mcpToolResults.userStopLine says it in that receipt and in every later nomi_read run
internal_only_reason: How a paid card is answered, withdrawn and stopped in the middle is Nomi's own spend-authority flow; no external protocol defines it.

invariant_owner_layer.why: Where a stop lands is decided only in the ledger: discardPendingSpend closes the offer (unbound hand-overs recorded withdrawn in the same command) and withdrawQueuedHandOvers withdraws the bound consents still queued; what was already dispatched is reported as sent. The renderer only sends the stop at once and draws what the host projects. agentPanelSpendCardStop.e2e covers 取消 with 0 / 1 / 3 shots in flight, a × before the bind, double clicks, typing, a closed window, a superseded presentation and a restart.

invariants: The card's 取消 reaches the host whenever it is pressed; nothing the card is doing at that moment can swallow it.

After a stop exactly the shots already handed to the provider (or still being handed over) are sent; consents still queued on the canvas are withdrawn, and the card's notice says how many were sent and how many were not. When every shot had already been handed over it does not say it stopped anything.
While shots are being handed over the card offers no per-shot action (no primary button, no 不生成 ×); while one action is on its way the others are visibly disabled.

On the scheduler path a user stop reports the same per-shot facts in nomi_run_control and in nomi_read run: K sent (they finish and bill as usual), M not sent (not charged); when every shot had already been sent it says the stop held back none and offers no continue.

door_reduction.why_not: The stop has one owner (discardPendingSpend writes the close; withdrawQueuedHandOvers is the ledger's own reaction to any close). The other doors are its IPC route, its wiring in appIntegration and the test world, and the card's readers of the result (the sending look and the stop notice). 2026-10-24 (debt b, second half): the scheduler path's stop words were one generic per-status hint (RUN_STATUS_HINT, a single read door, counted into before); they now read per-shot facts through four read doors: the one per-shot classifier shared with the landing-failure facts (shotSendFacts), the projection reader (shotStopFacts) and the two readers in the MCP receipts (userStopFacts / userStopLine). The generic hint stays for runs without per-shot facts.

generality_proof: Nothing depends on the model, vendor, shot kind or batch size: every close path is the same ledger command, the subscription withdraws queued consents for any presentation, and the notice reads the ledger outcome (image or video wording through the same rule as the title).

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Withdraws the offer in the ledger (generation.withdrawPresentation, user_closed); unbound hand-overs are recorded withdrawn in the same command. Answers batchStopped from the ledger only when this presentation handed shots over: sent = handed over or still being handed, notSent = undecided plus definitely not sent.
Ledger change subscription: when a presentation closes it withdraws every bound canvas consent that has not been dispatched yet, so no close path depends on a button remembering to do it.

The scheduler path's stop facts from the one per-shot classifier (shotSendFacts, the same "sent" criterion as the landing-failure facts): sent = may have reached the provider; not sent = not handed out yet, on the canvas or not; shots the user deleted or the canvas took over are not counted as held back.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Sent at once, never behind the busy guard; while a hand-over is in flight the card shows the stopping state (useAgentPanelSpendCard.test.ts).

same_class_entry_points.entry_point: generate / exclude / restore while an action is on its way
same_class_entry_points.evidence: Behind the busy guard and visibly disabled; while shots are being handed over the projection draws no primary and no exclusion toggles (agentPanelSpendCard.test.ts).

same_class_entry_points.entry_point: typing while the card is open / stopping the turn
same_class_entry_points.evidence: Closes the presentation through withdrawPresentation; withdrawQueuedHandOvers reacts to that close as to the card's (agentPanelSpendCardStop.e2e.test.ts user_wrote).

same_class_entry_points.entry_point: nomi_run_control pause / cancel and nomi_read run after a user stop of a scheduler batch
same_class_entry_points.evidence: landFirstMultiShot.test.ts stop matrix (stop during submit 1 / 3 / 6 x pause / cancel): the projection's stopped lists the sent and the not-sent shots; both receipts say "K sent, M not sent" or, when all were sent, that the stop held back none; no generic "unsubmitted jobs are not charged" line; no continue hint when nothing is left; English wording checked too.

recurrence.reason: The host-level test of 'stop in the middle' bypassed the renderer, so a green test and a broken user path coexisted; the same shape (a stop routed through the gate of the thing it stops) can come back with any new long-running card action.
same_class_scan: rg "withdrawPresentation|operations.withdraw" electron -> discardPendingSpend, laneExtendedDesktopPorts (redirected, stopped, no window), stalePresentationSweep (startup); every one closes through the ledger that withdrawQueuedHandOvers subscribes to

node scripts/door-map.mjs --read=shotStopFacts,userStopFacts,userStopLine (2026-10-24: 3 doors, the scheduler path's stop words); node scripts/door-map.mjs createMultiShotBatchScheduler (2026-10-24: appIntegration.ts x2, mcpStdioServer.ts and the test world)

prevention.invariant: A stop is one ledger command: it withdraws the offer and records unbound hand-overs as withdrawn, and the ledger subscription withdraws queued canvas consents; the card's 取消 is never queued behind the card's other actions.
prevention.failure_mode: A shot already dispatched when the stop lands is sent and paid; the notice counts it as sent.
prevention.strategy: Make the ledger the linearization point (close -> later binds refused -> queued consents withdrawn), send the stop from the renderer without the busy guard, and count the notice from the ledger.

legacy_paths.rationale: 2026-10-24, deleted with the old card: confirmRemainingShots (the host approving shot by shot and checking between shots for a close), noteReplacing / replacedInOpenPresentation, and the old renderer hook. The card hands all its shots to the canvas at once and a stop is a ledger command.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: No third-party dependency handles the card's actions.

migration: No stored data changes. 2026-10-24 D2 step 3 (design card docs/plan/2026-10-23-d2-pointer-spend-card.md; contract docs/fixes/2026-10-24-spend-card-one-engine.root-cause.json): the paid card became node pointers plus a read-only summary that hands its shots to the canvas engine; confirmRemainingShots (with the old renderer hook useAgentPanelSpendConfirm) was deleted with the old card, so this contract's boundaries, doors, tests and legacy paths were re-pointed to the code that holds the invariant today (problem, symptom, causes and class root above are the original record). 2026-10-24, debt b second half: the scheduler path (createMultiShotBatchScheduler still has callers after the card stopped using it) says the real per-shot counts after a user stop (run projection stopped; nomi_run_control and nomi_read run receipts).
residual_risks: A shot already dispatched to the provider when the stop lands cannot be recalled; it is generated and paid, and the notice counts it as sent.
With the network down, shots handed to the canvas fail to send one by one (not charged); the card shows each as not sent with 再试一次.
On the scheduler path a shot whose submit was in progress when the stop landed counts as sent (its submit intent is on disk and may have reached the provider).
